employment_issue.description: Substantive discussion of Indonesian employment hardships, unemployment, fresh grad struggles, layoffs (PHK), low wages, or unfavorable working conditions.

abroad_aspiration.description: Personal expression of intent, desire, plan, or active motivation to work overseas (e.g., personal #KaburAjaDulu, wanting a work visa abroad).

abroad_discourse.description: Public discussion, advice, informative sharing, news, or general societal debate regarding overseas employment for Indonesians, without necessarily expressing personal aspiration.

issue_abroad_link.description: Explicitly connects Indonesian domestic labor-market challenges (e.g. low salaries, age restrictions, PHK) to the aspiration or decision to seek employment abroad. Note: Only 6 tweets in the current corpus exhibit an explicit single-tweet causal link, and this classification remains provisional. (RQ3 is sentiment analysis across topics and aspirations and has NOT been executed yet).

constraints.link_requires_both: issue_abroad_link cannot be 1 unless the post provides explicit evidence connecting domestic employment problems to abroad opportunities or migration.
constraints.aspiration_vs_discourse: General discourse about working abroad must not be tagged as abroad_aspiration unless the author clearly expresses personal aspiration.
